metagateway.rationale: MetaGateway proxy: punto de entrada unico que enruta queries a 5 sub-gateways especializados (media, code, infra, knowledge, shell) usando exact match + embeddings. Fail isolation entre dominios.

superpowers.rationale: Superpowers development workflow system: 14 skills (brainstorming, TDD, planning, code review, etc.) wrapped as MCP tools. Lazy-loaded, invoked only when needed via gateway.

n8n_native.rationale: n8n native MCP server (built-in) via HTTP→stdio bridge. 27 tools: workflow CRUD, node discovery, Data Tables, testing, validation, SDK reference, projects, folders, credentials, executions. Runs inside n8n container — zero extra disk or process overhead.

n8n_lint.rationale: Focused n8n debugging and first-run-correctness MCP for workflow generation (NL→JSON), linting (20+ rules), semantic diffs, execution diagnosis (explain, replay, timeline), and node scaffolding. ~167KB, read-only mode enabled.
